seo_description: Lars Walraevens is a software developer in region Antwerp. Here you can find more information about his expertise in software development and his portfolio
hero_intro: I build full-stack web apps and care most about how the user experience feels.
hero_tooltip_music: Hardwave is what I vibe to! 🎧
hero_tooltip_gaming: I play lots of PC games 🎮
hero_tooltip_tennis: My sport of choice is tennis 🎾
section_about_skills_description: I'm a full-stack developer who likes owning a feature from the first pixel to the last query: React and Next.js up front, .NET, Azure and the database behind it. What I care about most is how the UX feels like, and AI is currently my go-to tool to get there efficiently.
section_about_motivation_description1: One of my favorite things about software development is the ability to bring beautiful products to life. Seeing a great idea or a well-crafted design is like a call to action for me - I can't wait to jump in and start building. As a software developer, I am passionate about working efficiently and continuously improving my skills.
section_about_motivation_description2: In my projects I like to pay attention to the UX and UI aspects of software. Hence, I look for a pleasant user experience for visitors.
section_projects_description: Below are projects that I have worked on with great pride and that I would like to share with you.
section_contact_description: If you're interested in connecting or have any questions, feel free to shoot me a message, preferably via LinkedIn. I'll get back to you as promptly as possible!
main_404_description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.
project_sethub_description: Sethub is a personal project that I build and run on my own. Gamers share their setup part by part: you list your build down to the mousepad, Sethub draws it as a blueprint on your profile, and you can see who runs the same parts and read reviews from people who actually own them.
project_autinoom_description: Autinoom was in need of a fresh and modern website, so I took the first step to create a wireframe design for the new site. Eventually, the wireframe design evolved into a stunning new WordPress website that effectively met their needs.
project_waarisdegrens_description: On behalf of KdG, we have developed a website where visitors can vote whether a certain situation crosses 'the border' or not. The project is developed with a mobile-first approach.
project_sonar_description: Sonar Events is an innovative ticketing platform designed for event organizers & partygoers. With the user-friendly dashboard, organizers can quickly and easily set up their event page and publish it to the website for seamless ticket sales. The platform streamlines the process, making it easy for partygoers to purchase tickets with just a few clicks.
project_zmadstudios_description: Vince De Groot's small business needed to an upgrade to their website, I helped him out by creating a new design & website, I took the opportunity to expand my skills and learn more about working the framework VueJS.
section_about_other_description1: My daily driver is Linux, running Fedora as my workstation. These days I mostly do agentic coding through T3 Code, with Claude Code and Codex as my providers. When it comes to frameworks and libraries, I love building with Next.js, TanStack Query, shadcn/ui, Jotai and Zod. Curious how it's all set up? My dotfiles and util library are public.
project_myjobbox_description: myJobbox is my professional work. It is a digital career coach that supports job seekers 24/7: from working out what they want, to keeping their applications organised and preparing for the next conversation. I work across the whole platform: the app for job seekers, the business platform coaching organisations use to guide their talents between sessions, the internal office tool, and the .NET APIs on Azure behind them.
project_apidocs_description: I had to create an API documentation site at some point and thought to myself, why not make it open-source. So that's what I did so that other people could use it too. It uses a JSON data structure to render content & navigation. Plus it also has some useful components.
project_chronic_diary_description: I struggle with chronic symptoms. Thats why I created a diary (web app) to track different chronic symptoms I was feeling during the day. The platform is developed with a mobile-first approach.
project_drone_mallorca_description: When I'm on vacation, I like to fly my drone to make cinematic videos. This is a video montage of one of my favorite places I visited - Mallorca. I absolutely love how it turned out.
project_talentguide_description: I had the opportunity to be temporarily assigned to the Talentguide team as a Full Stack Developer. A core feature I developed was the Personal Development Plan tool. Using identified skill gaps (by comparing a candidate's skills to a job role) we can generate a tailored plan using LLMs. Each plan includes customizable modules with settings like evaluation criteria and learning paths (on-the-job, education, social) etc. Plans are seperately viewable by both candidates and managers in their respective UI. Additionally, I coded module navigation and integrated mailing flows triggered by user actions & automations.
project_aloxy_description: I had the opportunity to be temporarily assigned to the Aloxy team as a frontend developer. I contributed to a full rewrite of the IoT Hub, immensely improving usability. Also built a new core feature called Monitoring Sets — enabling grouped sensor monitoring with alert functionalities, P&ID mapping, a geographic visualization and more. Alongside this, I helped with migrating all existing pages to the new codebase, ensuring a smooth transition.
